# Jaai and ArcticQuests

> Professional portfolio for Jaai, a developer and modder.

## About

Jaai is a full-stack developer specializing in Minecraft modding with Fabric and Java. 
Jaai founded ArcticQuests, a game development studio focused on custom mods, web applications, 
and open-source contributions to the Minecraft ecosystem.

Years of experience: 4+
Primary focus: Minecraft modding, web development, game development
Main technologies: Java, Fabric API, TypeScript, React, Python

## Web Technologies

This portfolio is built with:
- React 18
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Vite + Vite Plus unified toolchain
- Framer Motion for animations
- Radix UI components
